title: 第4章  腹黑赵明辉，都有心理阴影了！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
烈日当空，装甲旅训练场。
机械化步兵一连的新兵们穿戴整齐，军姿挺拔伫立在训练场中央。
队列前方，班长刘畅双手背在身后来回踱步。
他眉眼凌厉，一副铁血教官的模样。
此刻他脸色黑得像锅底，眼神扫过下方一排排新兵，越看越窝火，胸腔里的火气蹭蹭往上冒。
“抬腿！收腹！下颌微收！一个个耷拉着脑袋干什么？没睡醒？”
刘畅猛地停步，厉声呵斥，声音洪亮，震得一众新兵浑身一僵。
“站个军姿都站不明白，队列松松垮垮，一动就晃，跟没长骨头一样！门口的老太太都比你们站的利索！我带了这么多兵，就没见过你们这么差的底子！”
新兵们个个噤若寒蝉，没人敢抬头对视。
可看到一众新兵们如此，刘畅的火气更大。
“一群废物！都怎么了？一点尿水都没有了？啊！”
刘畅恨铁不成钢地怒骂一句，可依旧没有人敢抬头。
就在这时，队列最右侧，二年兵队列中，王冲忍不住压低声音，小声跟着身旁的二年兵嘟囔了一句：“说白了……就是觉得林毅退伍走了，班长心里空得慌，看我们谁都不顺眼呗。”
“说得对……”一个二年兵跟着小声嘟囔。
刘畅眼神凌厉如刀，猛地转头看向了王冲。
“王冲！”
他冷哼一句，问道：“你刚刚说什么？大声重复一遍！”
王冲浑身一哆嗦，顿时头皮发麻，只能硬着头皮跨出队列，立正站好：“报告班长！我说您就是觉得我们比不上林毅！林毅退伍走了，您心里舍不得，看我们怎么练都不顺眼！”
刘畅当场炸毛，双目圆瞪：“放你妈的屁！老子会舍不得那个混小子？”
“他娘的，在部队待了六年，给老子惹了六年的祸！老子会舍不得他？放屁！王冲，你真是皮……”

“咳。”
话音未落，一道轻咳声响起。
刘畅当即止住声音，回头望向声音传来的方向。
随即高声喝道：“全体都有！立正！稍息！继续定型训练，谁敢乱动加练一小时！”
紧接着，他猛地扭身，站定脚步，抬手敬礼：“副连长！”
来人正是赵明辉。
赵明辉微微颔首，目光没有多余波动，视线落在刘畅领口，眉头蹙起：“衣服领子歪了。”
刘畅下意识抬手一摸，果然歪了。
他心里暗自苦笑，不愧是赵明辉，连队里出了名的强迫症。
刘畅不敢耽搁，飞快抬手整理衣领、抚平褶皱。
“报告连长，整理完毕！”
赵明辉这才收回目光，神色恢复如常：“刚接到旅部通知，地方烟城一中需要我方派遣骨干官兵，负责新生军训。”
“你们一排是主力尖刀排，骨干底子硬，我过来问问，你这边有没有合适的人选推荐？”
刘畅几乎是不假思索，脱口而出：“报告连长！首选林毅！那小子最……”
话音未落，他整个人骤然一僵。
刘畅举在半空的手缓缓落下，他挠了挠后脑勺：“忘了……嘿嘿，这小子今天刚走。”
赵明辉笑了笑，语气带着几分了然：“看这样子，你是真舍不得他啊。”
刘畅长叹一口气：“说实话，确实有点舍不得。”
“那小子刺头是真刺头，全连最能折腾的就是他，天天给我惹麻烦，三天两头让我头疼上火。”
“但不得不承认，他是实打实的好兵。”

刘畅眼神望向训练场：“这小子当了六年兵，经验极其丰富，有时候刚来了新兵，他就一手带了，根本不用我费什么心。”
“唉，还是挺想他的。”
赵明辉翻了个白眼：“你那是想他吗？你那是想他帮你带兵！”
“嘿嘿……”刘畅干笑了几声，眼神顺势看向了部队大门的方向。
看着看着，他好像看到了一个人，一个戴着大红花，背着行囊，满脸苦闷，跟谁都欠他二五八万的人，一步一步的朝着这里走来。
可再一看，那个人根本不存在。
他抿了抿嘴，叹了口气。
“看到林毅了？”赵明辉幽幽开口。
刘畅点点头：“是啊，副连长，你说这小子每次走了之后，当天就回来了，他这次真就走了？”
“不然呢？你还真巴望着他回来？”赵明辉问道。
刘畅一脸纠结：“怎么说呢，走了也挺好的，不至于在部队里遭罪，以他家的条件，出去了照样能混的风生水起，吃穿不愁。”
“这不就得了，咱们还在这为他发愁呢，搞不好这小子现在正在花天酒地呢。”赵明辉冷哼了一声。
听到赵明辉的语气，刘畅抬眼看向他试探着开口：“副连长，你也舍不得吧？”
赵明辉眼神一凛：“放屁！我巴不得他早点走！”
刘畅顺势打趣：“既然您这么想他走，那您日理万机，军务繁忙，就为了一个军训派遣的小事亲自跑一趟咱们训练场？随便让值班员传个话不就行了？”
赵明辉脸色微微一沉，旋即嘴角上扬，语气意味深长：“老刘，我觉得你在一连，有点屈才了。”
刘畅：“？？？”
赵明辉语气平淡道：“旅部那边，工兵抢修连最近缺骨干，那里才是最适合发挥你能力的地方。”
一听这话，刘畅想都没想直接疯狂摆手：“别别别！连长！我在一连待得特别好，一点都不屈才！我深爱一连，坚守岗位，绝不调动！”
开玩笑？工兵抢修连！

那可是全旅公认的炼狱岗位，苦累排名第一，别人躲都来不及，谁会主动往上凑？
赵明辉这哪里是提拔，分明是他娘的杀人诛心、敲打自己乱说话！
林毅以前就跟他说过，赵明辉看着一本正经、不苟言笑，实则腹黑得要命，最擅长不动声色的搞别人。
该说不说的，林毅这小子看人是真准啊。
赵明辉淡然开口道：“嗯，知道珍惜岗位就好好干，别整天胡思乱想、唠闲嗑，好好琢磨一下军训人选，晚上之前把名单报给我。”
“是！保证完成任务！”刘畅立马挺直腰板，标准敬礼。
赵明辉不再多言，转身迈步离开。
看着他彻底走远的背影，刘畅这才长长松了一口气。
但很快，问题就随之浮现在心中。
所以，该派谁去呢？
这般想着，他转头望向了正在训练的第二年的老兵队列。
content_en:
The scorching sun shines in the sky at the armored brigade training ground.
The recruits of the first company of mechanized infantry were neatly dressed and standing in the center of the training ground with a straight military posture.
At the front of the queue, squad leader Liu Chang was pacing back and forth with his hands behind his back.
He had sharp eyebrows and looked like an iron-blooded instructor.
At this moment, his face was as dark as the bottom of a pot, and his eyes swept across the rows of recruits below. The more he looked at them, the more angry he became, and the anger in his chest was rising.
"Raise your legs! Tuck your abdomen! Slightly tuck your jaw! What are you doing with your heads hanging down? Are you still awake?"
Liu Chang stopped abruptly and shouted harshly, his voice so loud that the recruits froze.
"I can't even stand in a military posture. The queue is loose and swaying when I move, as if I have no bones! The old lady at the door can stand better than you! I have led so many soldiers, and I have never seen you with such a bad foundation!"
The recruits were all silent, no one dared to raise their heads and look at each other.
But seeing the new recruits like this, Liu Chang became even more angry.
"A bunch of trash! What happened? Is there no urine left at all? Ah!"
Liu Chang cursed angrily, but no one dared to raise their head.
At this moment, on the far right side of the queue, in the queue of second-year soldiers, Wang Chong couldn't help but lower his voice and muttered to the second-year soldier beside him: "To put it bluntly... I just feel that Lin Yi has retired from the army and left, and the squad leader is feeling empty. He doesn't like any of us."
"You're right..." A second-year soldier muttered.
Liu Chang's eyes were as sharp as a knife, and he suddenly turned his head to look at Wang Chong.
"Wang Chong!"
He snorted coldly and asked, "What did you just say? Repeat it loudly!"
Wang Chong trembled all over, and his scalp suddenly became numb. He could only step out of the queue and stand at attention: "Report to the squad leader! I said you just think that we are not as good as Lin Yi! Lin Yi has retired from the army, and you are reluctant to let it go. No matter how we practice, you don't like it!"
Liu Chang was furious on the spot, his eyes widened: "Fuck you! Will I be reluctant to let go of that bastard?"
"Damn it, he has been in the army for six years and caused me six years of trouble! Will I be reluctant to let him go? Fart! Wang Chong, you are so naughty..."
"Ahem."
Before he finished speaking, a slight cough sounded.
Liu Chang stopped his voice immediately and turned back to look in the direction from which the voice came.
Then he shouted loudly: "Everyone is here! Stand at attention! Take a break! Continue the regular training. Who dares to move and practice for an extra hour!"
Then, he turned around suddenly, stood still, raised his hand and saluted: "Deputy company commander!"
The person who came was none other than Zhao Minghui.
Zhao Minghui nodded slightly, without any unnecessary fluctuation in his eyes. His eyes fell on Liu Chang's collar, and he frowned: "The collar of the clothes is crooked."
Liu Chang subconsciously raised his hand and touched it, and it was indeed crooked.
He smiled bitterly in his heart, as expected of Zhao Minghui, who was famous for his obsessive-compulsive disorder in the company.
Liu Chang didn't dare to delay, and quickly raised his hand to straighten his collar and smooth out the wrinkles.
"Report to the company commander, sorting out!"
Only then did Zhao Minghui look away and his expression returned to normal: "I just received a notice from the brigade headquarters that the local Yancheng No. 1 Middle School needs us to send key officers and soldiers to be responsible for the military training of new students."
"Your platoon is the main sharp knife platoon with a strong backbone. I'm here to ask if you have any suitable candidates to recommend?"
Liu Chang blurted out almost without thinking: "Report to the company commander! Lin Yi is the first choice! That kid is the best..."
Before he finished speaking, his whole body suddenly froze.
Liu Chang's hand raised in the air slowly fell down, and he scratched the back of his head: "I forgot...hehe, this kid just left today."
Zhao Minghui smiled and said with a clear tone: "Looking like this, you really can't let him go."
Liu Chang sighed: "To be honest, I'm really reluctant to let go."
"That kid is really thorny. He is the most troublesome in the whole company. He causes me trouble every day and gives me headaches and anger every two days."
"But I have to admit that he is a real good soldier."
Liu Chang looked at the training ground: "This guy has been a soldier for six years.He is extremely experienced. Sometimes when new recruits arrive, he will take care of them without me having to worry about them. "
"Oh, I still miss him. "
Zhao Minghui rolled his eyes: "Do you miss him? You want him to help you lead the troops! "
"Hehe..." Liu Chang laughed a few times and looked in the direction of the army gate.
As he looked at it, he seemed to see a man, a man wearing a big red flower, carrying a bag on his back, with a depressed face, and who owed him 25,800,000 yuan to everyone, walking towards here step by step.
But when I looked again, that person didn't exist at all.
He pursed his lips and sighed.
"Have you seen Ji Ji? "Zhao Minghui said quietly.
Liu Chang nodded: "Yes, deputy company commander, you said that every time this kid left, he came back the same day. Did he really leave this time? "
"What if? Do you really want him to come back? " Zhao Minghui asked.
Liu Chang looked troubled: "How should I put it, it's good to leave, as he won't suffer in the army. With his family's conditions, he can still have a prosperous life and have no worries about food and clothing. "
"That's it, we are still worrying about him. Maybe this kid is having a great time. "Zhao Minghui snorted coldly.
Hearing Zhao Minghui's tone, Liu Chang looked up at him and said tentatively: "Deputy company commander, you can't bear to leave, right? "
Zhao Minghui's eyes flashed: "Fart! I wish he would leave soon! "
Liu Chang took advantage of the situation and joked: "Since you want him to leave so much, then you have so many things to do and are busy with military affairs, so you just went to our training ground in person for a small matter of military training dispatch? Can't we just ask the attendant to pass on a message? "
Zhao Minghui's face sank slightly, and then the corners of his mouth raised, and his tone was meaningful: "Old Liu, I think you are a bit inferior to your talents. "
Liu Chang: "? ? ? "
Zhao Minghui said in a calm tone: "Over at the brigade headquarters, the engineer emergency repair company is currently short of backbones, and that is the most suitable place to display your abilities. "
Upon hearing this, Liu Chang waved his hands frantically without even thinking: "No, no, no!" Company commander! I had a great time in the company, and I didn’t give in to my talents at all! I love Yilian deeply, stick to my post, and will never be transferred! "
Are you kidding? Engineer emergency repair company!
That is the purgatory position recognized by the entire brigade. It ranks first in terms of hardship and exhaustion. No one else has time to hide. Who would take the initiative to join in?
How could Zhao Minghui be promoted? He was clearly just trying to kill people, beat himself up and talk nonsense!
Lin Yi had told him before that Zhao Minghui looked serious and serious, but in fact he was extremely sinister and was best at teasing others quietly.
It’s time to say it or not, Lin Yi is a really good judge of people.
Zhao Minghui said calmly: "Well, if you know how to cherish your position, do it well. Don't think and chat all day long. Think carefully about the candidates for military training and submit the list to me before evening. "
"yes! Guaranteed to complete the task! "Liu Chang straightened his back immediately and gave a standard salute.
Zhao Minghui said no more, turned around and walked away.
Looking at his back as he walked away completely, Liu Chang let out a long sigh of relief.
But soon, questions emerged in my mind.
So, who should be sent?
Thinking like this, he turned his head and looked at the queue of second-year veterans who were training.
